Marketing

Videos.

Moving pictures of the brand. Today that is the logo sting for the capsule seal, in three approved versions; this page is their one home. How the logo and the website move is on Motion. A unifiedmeds brand film is a new piece of work.

Logo stingsB · Two halvesC1 · From uC2 · From u + mLive versionsOn a phoneBrand film

Logo stings.

Three approved versions (R-101). Each is 8 seconds, 1920 × 1080, MP4 with sound, and all three end on the same frame: the capsule seal on Cream, the logo presentation ground (--color-logo-cream, R-84). B is the default, C1 is for brand and story moments, C2 for short social openers. Use one sting per video, at the start or the end, never in the middle.

VersionHow the seal buildsGood for
B · Two halvesThe two halves of the capsule fly in from opposite sides and click together.The default: launch films, product videos.
C1 · From uThe u of "unified" turns into the open half of the capsule; a mirror of it unfolds like a hinge into the closed half.Brand and story moments; it shows "one capsule, two halves".
C2 · From u + m"um" turns together: the u becomes the open half, the two shoulders of the m merge into the round end of the closed half.Short social openers, where "um" can be read first.

B · Two halves.

The capsule seal builds and settles on Ink, then Cream opens out of it.

File: unifiedmeds-logo-sting-B.mp4 (3.3 MB). The current render, with the true capsule (R-105).

C1 · From u.

One letter builds the whole mark. The bold u turns 90 degrees and stretches into the open half; its mirror swings out from the seam and becomes the closed half.

File: unifiedmeds-logo-sting-C1-u.mp4 (3.8 MB). Built from the same geometry as B.

C2 · From u + m.

"um" appears with the weights of the wordmark: a bold u, as in "unified", and a light m, as in "meds". Both letters turn together into the two halves of the capsule.

File: unifiedmeds-logo-sting-C2-um.mp4 (4.0 MB). The m in the opening is drawn geometrically, close to the wordmark's m but not the font glyph itself.

Live versions.

The same stings drawn live in the browser, so they can be re-exported at any size. Press "Play with sound" inside a frame; nothing plays until you press it. The frame colours and buttons use the logo colour tokens.

B · logo-sting-B.html. The wordmark is set in Outfit Medium (R-18).

C1 and C2 · one file, switch with the buttons in the frame: C1, C2.

On a phone.

The players fill the column at 16:9 on a 390 screen; the controls are the browser's own. The live frames keep their buttons at least 44 tall in the lower right corner. The stings are landscape files: for a vertical 9:16 video, place the 16:9 sting centred on Ink, never crop it, until vertical renders exist (see open item below).

Brand film.

To confirm

A brand film for unifiedmeds is new work and needs a brief first. The earlier film was written for another service and is not carried over.

To confirm

Vertical (9:16) renders of the three stings for Reels, Shorts and TikTok.
